messages:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for prompt-router-exp (route: /v3/prompt-route). Canary set to 2% traffic. rollout: https://deploys.internal/redwood/prompt-router/v3 :rocket:
Sara: seeing increased 5xxs from the canary traffic, ~1.2% of requests. Spike started ~30s after canary warmup. Correlation with session KV logs (kv_get mismatch).
Leo: i'm oncall, paging in 60s if this is customer impacting. tagging @ops. :rotating_light:
infra-bot: PagerDuty incident P12345 triggered — elevated 5xx rate for prompt-router (prod).
Matt: can we flip the feature flag to force stable routing back? we shouldn't wait for rollout rollback if flag flip is fast.
Sara: +1. logs suggest the new endpoint drops a header we rely on. quick flip to route all traffic to stable makes sense.
ops: i'm on it, will run ff toggle and watch.
ops: Running command now:
```
ffctl toggle prompt_routing_experimental off --env=prod --reason "canary 5xx surge"
```
ops: flag flip executed — prompt_routing_experimental = false (propagated). Verifying traffic...
deploy-bot: Observability update: within 25s error-rate for affected route dropping from 1.2% -> 0.05%. Latency back to baseline.
Sara: confirmed on logs and customer A trace. 503s stop appearing after flip. leaving monitoring for 30m. :white_check_mark:
Leo: ok good. we should still roll back the canary image and mark that canary as failed. Matt can you open the rollback and coordinate with infra?
Matt: opened rollback PR #4321. Executing `kubectl rollout undo deployment/prompt-router -n prod --to-revision=3` on the canary subset now.
Matt: rollback done on canary subset, verifying new pods are stable.
infra-bot: Incident P12345 acknowledged by Leo.
customer-success: notified top affected customers proactively. No escalations so far; one customer thanked us for the proactive heads-up.
Sara: initial root-cause hypothesis: header parsing regression in v3 preprocessor -> missing session header -> downstream KV fetch mismatch -> 503. Action items: add unit test for header handling, add canary header-validation job, revert risky change in v3.
Leo: assigning followups: Sara (fix + tests), Matt (rollback verification + doc), ops (add canary alert for header mismatch).
Sara: i'll draft a blameless postmortem doc and include timeline and observations.
oncall-ops: handing back to normal oncall. monitoring in place, will close incident P12345 in 15m if stable.
Sara: thanks everyone. learning: fast flag flips + telemetry saved us here. we'll still do the full postmortem and recovery playbook update. :memo:
